messages:
jon: Quick follow-up after the RFC — proposing a tiny 'polyfill-proxy' to handle old client request shapes. Keep it behind a tenant flag, enable canary, then toggle for orgs that opt in. Thoughts?
maya: Sounds reasonable. Main worry: streaming semantics. If we mutate frames we can add tail latency.
kevin: For streaming, we should avoid re-encoding tokens. Plan: map legacy frames into an envelope and pass through the original chunks when possible. Only translate header/footers.
aj: Also capture clear telemetry. Metric suggestions: `compat.polyfill.requests`, `compat.polyfill.fallbacks`, `compat.polyfill.latency_p50/p95`.
pr-deploy-bot: deploy queued: compat-proxy-canary -> staging in 18m :rocket:
sre_oncall: We need a circuit-breaker. If proxy p95 > 250ms for 5m or error-rate > 1% then fail-open to a 429 with `Retry-After` and `X-RI-Compat-Status: degraded`.
maya: +1 on CB. Also require an opt-in header so customers can choose to allow transformations: `X-RI-Compat: v1-allow`. Default should be opt-out.
jon: Agree on opt-in. Proposal: opt-in for first 2 months, then we flip to opt-out warning-only for another month (via `X-RI-Deprecation: scheduled`), then start blocking after 3 months unless they've migrated.
kevin: I'll prototype the envelope format. Example: ```json
{ "compat_version": "v1", "payload": <legacy-chunk> }
```
This keeps transformer logic tiny.
aj: Add a small eval harness comparing outputs from native v3 vs polyfilled v1 for a few prompt families. Put results in PR.
jon: Rollout runbook items I want: canary (1% traffic), smoke tests (latency, error rate, streaming integrity), perf budget (p50 +10ms, p95 +30ms), telemetry dashboards, rollback playbook. I'll draft tomorrow.
sre_oncall: Also include a label in traces to tie requests back to tenant flag: `meta.compat_proxy=true`.
maya: One more ops note: limit polyfill lifetime (6 months max). Add a scheduled deprecation notice to customers and require migration plans.
jon: Cool. I'll create a GH issue with checklist and owners. kevin/aj — please follow up on envelope tests and telemetry hooks. :thumbsup:
kevin: On it, will mock flaky networks too (out-of-order chunks).
aj: I'll prepare dashboards and an alert for the CB thresholds.
jon: Thanks all. If no objections I'll start the canary next week. :shipit:
